name: CTOS Digital Berhad
overview: CTOS Digital Berhad 今年完成出售其在 Juris Technologies Sdn Bhd 的 10% 股权，套现 RM50.0 million，并已全额以现金收取。公司同时派发多次中期股息及一次特别股息。最新一季（2026年9月30日止）营收同比增长10.8%，净利润同比增长30.2%。
overview_en: CTOS Digital Berhad completed the disposal of its 10% stake in Juris Technologies Sdn Bhd for RM50.0 million in cash this year. The company also declared several interim dividends and one special dividend. For the latest quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue rose 10.8% year-on-year and net profit rose 30.2% year-on-year.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年完成出售 Juris Technologies 的 10% 股权，并派发中期及特别股息。
segments.note_en: Completed the disposal of a 10% stake in Juris Technologies and declared interim and special dividends this year.

actions.title: CTOS - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 宣布第三次单层中期股息每股 0.70 sen。
actions.text_en: Declared a third single-tier interim dividend of 0.70 sen per share.

actions.title: CTOS - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 宣布特别单层股息每股 1.07 sen。
actions.text_en: Declared a special single-tier dividend of 1.07 sen per share.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 上述出售于 2026 年 7 月 29 日完成。
actions.text_en: The disposal was completed on 29 July 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 就出售 Juris Technologies 10% 股权提供额外资料。
actions.text_en: Provided additional information on the disposal of the 10% stake in Juris Technologies.

actions.title: CTOS - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 宣布第二次单层中期股息每股 0.70 sen。
actions.text_en: Declared a second single-tier interim dividend of 0.70 sen per share.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 与 Natsoft 签订股份出售协议，以 RM50.0 million 现金出售 Juris Technologies Sdn Bhd 的 10% 股权（100,000 股）。
actions.text_en: Entered into a share sale agreement with Natsoft to dispose of 100,000 shares representing 10% of Juris Technologies Sdn Bhd for RM50.0 million cash.

actions.title: CTOS - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 宣布第一次单层中期股息每股 0.57 sen。
actions.text_en: Declared a first single-tier interim dividend of 0.57 sen per share.

model_changes.text: 出售 Juris Technologies Sdn Bhd 的 10% 股权，退出该部分投资。
model_changes.text_en: Disposed of a 10% stake in Juris Technologies Sdn Bhd, exiting that investment.
